_comment: Hand-authored Custom Elements Manifest for the native SVG element vocabulary, the flags input to elm-cem's phantom generator. Same role native.cem.json plays for the html brand, authored the same way: from the W3C SVG spec + MDN SVG element/attribute reference, cross-checked against elm/svg's curated element+attribute set. Only ELEMENT-SPECIFIC (geometry / structural) attributes live here; the universal presentation attributes (fill, stroke, transform, opacity, ...) are declared once as open-row _globals in ../../../inputs/config.json, exactly as the WHATWG global attributes are for html. Every attribute type is `string`: SVG length/coordinate/number values are all strings at the DOM boundary ("10", "50%", "0 0 100 100"), and the case-sensitive camelCase names (viewBox, gradientUnits, preserveAspectRatio) are preserved verbatim as the DOM attribute name by elm-cem (Attr.htmlName).

declarations.name: Svg
declarations.description: The root SVG element and a nested viewport. Establishes a new coordinate system and viewport.

attributes.name: viewBox
attributes.description: The position and dimension of the SVG viewport, `min-x min-y width height`.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Horizontal length of the viewport.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Vertical length of the viewport.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of a nested SVG viewport.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of a nested SVG viewport.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How to scale the viewBox to fit the viewport.

attributes.name: xmlns
attributes.description: The SVG XML namespace declaration (`http://www.w3.org/2000/svg`).

declarations.name: G
declarations.description: A container that groups other SVG elements. Transforms and presentation attributes on a group apply to all its children.

declarations.name: Defs
declarations.description: A container for reusable graphical objects (gradients, patterns, symbols) that are not rendered directly but referenced elsewhere.

declarations.name: Symbol
declarations.description: A template graphical object that is instantiated by a `use` element. Not rendered on its own.

attributes.name: viewBox
attributes.description: The viewBox for the symbol's contents.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How to scale the viewBox when instantiated.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the symbol's viewport when instantiated.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the symbol's viewport when instantiated.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the symbol's viewport when instantiated.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the symbol's viewport when instantiated.

declarations.name: Use
declarations.description: Instantiates (clones) another element or symbol identified by `href`.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to the element to instantiate (a URL fragment, e.g. `#id`).

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X offset of the instantiated element.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y offset of the instantiated element.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width override for the instantiated symbol/svg.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height override for the instantiated symbol/svg.

declarations.name: A
declarations.description: An SVG hyperlink. Wraps graphical content in a link.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: The URL the hyperlink points to.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Where to display the linked resource.

declarations.name: Switch
declarations.description: Renders the first of its direct children whose feature/requirement test attributes evaluate true.

declarations.name: Title
declarations.description: An accessible short-text description of its parent element. Not rendered as graphics.

declarations.name: Desc
declarations.description: An accessible long-text description of its parent element. Not rendered as graphics.

declarations.name: Rect
declarations.description: A rectangle, optionally with rounded corners.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the rectangle.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the rectangle.

attributes.name: rx
attributes.description: Horizontal corner radius.

attributes.name: ry
attributes.description: Vertical corner radius.

declarations.name: Circle
declarations.description: A circle centred at (cx, cy) with radius r.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.description: X coordinate of the centre.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the centre.

attributes.name: r
attributes.description: Radius.

declarations.name: Ellipse
declarations.description: An ellipse centred at (cx, cy) with radii rx and ry.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.description: X coordinate of the centre.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the centre.

attributes.name: rx
attributes.description: Horizontal radius.

attributes.name: ry
attributes.description: Vertical radius.

declarations.name: Line
declarations.description: A straight line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

attributes.name: x1
attributes.description: X coordinate of the start point.

attributes.name: y1
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the start point.

attributes.name: x2
attributes.description: X coordinate of the end point.

attributes.name: y2
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the end point.

declarations.name: Polyline
declarations.description: An open shape connecting a series of points with straight lines.

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: The list of points, `x1,y1 x2,y2 ...`.

declarations.name: Polygon
declarations.description: A closed shape connecting a series of points with straight lines.

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: The list of points, `x1,y1 x2,y2 ...`.

declarations.name: Path
declarations.description: A shape defined by a path-data string of move/line/curve/arc commands.

attributes.name: d
attributes.description: The path-data command string.

attributes.name: pathLength
attributes.description: The author's computed total length of the path.

declarations.name: Text
declarations.description: A graphics element consisting of text.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the starting text position.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the starting text baseline.

attributes.name: dx
attributes.description: Horizontal shift from the current text position.

attributes.name: dy
attributes.description: Vertical shift from the current text position.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Per-glyph rotation, in degrees.

attributes.name: textLength
attributes.description: Target rendered length of the text.

attributes.name: lengthAdjust
attributes.description: How to fit the text to textLength (`spacing` or `spacingAndGlyphs`).

declarations.name: Tspan
declarations.description: A run of text inside a `text` element with its own position/styling.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: Absolute X coordinate for this run.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Absolute Y coordinate for this run.

attributes.name: dx
attributes.description: Horizontal shift from the current position.

attributes.name: dy
attributes.description: Vertical shift from the current position.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Per-glyph rotation, in degrees.

declarations.name: TextPath
declarations.description: Text laid out along the shape of a referenced `path`.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to the path the text is laid out along.

attributes.name: startOffset
attributes.description: Offset from the start of the path where the text begins.

declarations.name: LinearGradient
declarations.description: A linear colour gradient defined by `stop` children, referenced as a paint value.

attributes.name: x1
attributes.description: X coordinate of the gradient vector start.

attributes.name: y1
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the gradient vector start.

attributes.name: x2
attributes.description: X coordinate of the gradient vector end.

attributes.name: y2
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the gradient vector end.

attributes.name: gradientUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the gradient (`userSpaceOnUse` or `objectBoundingBox`).

attributes.name: gradientTransform
attributes.description: An additional transform applied to the gradient.

attributes.name: spreadMethod
attributes.description: How the gradient repeats beyond its bounds (`pad`, `reflect`, `repeat`).

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to another gradient whose attributes/stops are inherited.

declarations.name: RadialGradient
declarations.description: A radial colour gradient defined by `stop` children, referenced as a paint value.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.description: X coordinate of the gradient's outermost circle centre.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the gradient's outermost circle centre.

attributes.name: r
attributes.description: Radius of the outermost circle.

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: X coordinate of the focal point.

attributes.name: fy
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the focal point.

attributes.name: fr
attributes.description: Radius of the focal circle.

attributes.name: gradientUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the gradient.

attributes.name: gradientTransform
attributes.description: An additional transform applied to the gradient.

attributes.name: spreadMethod
attributes.description: How the gradient repeats beyond its bounds.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to another gradient whose attributes/stops are inherited.

declarations.name: Stop
declarations.description: A single colour stop in a gradient.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Position of the stop along the gradient (0 to 1, or a percentage).

attributes.name: stop-color
attributes.description: The colour of this stop.

attributes.name: stop-opacity
attributes.description: The opacity of this stop.

declarations.name: Pattern
declarations.description: A tiling pattern of its child content, referenced as a paint value.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the pattern tile.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the pattern tile.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the pattern tile.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the pattern tile.

attributes.name: patternUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the tile geometry.

attributes.name: patternContentUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the tile's contents.

attributes.name: patternTransform
attributes.description: An additional transform applied to the pattern.

attributes.name: viewBox
attributes.description: A viewBox for the pattern's contents.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How to scale the pattern viewBox.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to another pattern whose attributes/content are inherited.

declarations.name: ClipPath
declarations.description: Defines a clipping region from its child shapes, referenced via the clip-path property.

attributes.name: clipPathUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the clip path contents.

declarations.name: Mask
declarations.description: Defines an alpha/luminance mask from its child content, referenced via the mask property.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the mask region.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the mask region.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the mask region.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the mask region.

attributes.name: maskUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the mask region geometry.

attributes.name: maskContentUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for the mask's contents.

declarations.name: Marker
declarations.description: A graphic (arrowhead, dot) drawn at vertices of a path/line/polyline/polygon.

attributes.name: markerWidth
attributes.description: Width of the marker viewport.

attributes.name: markerHeight
attributes.description: Height of the marker viewport.

attributes.name: refX
attributes.description: X coordinate of the marker's reference point (aligned to the vertex).

attributes.name: refY
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the marker's reference point.

attributes.name: orient
attributes.description: Marker orientation (`auto`, `auto-start-reverse`, or an angle).

attributes.name: markerUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system for markerWidth/markerHeight (`strokeWidth` or `userSpaceOnUse`).

attributes.name: viewBox
attributes.description: A viewBox for the marker's contents.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How to scale the marker viewBox.

declarations.name: Image
declarations.description: A raster or SVG image referenced by `href` and drawn into a rectangle.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to the image resource.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: X coordinate of the image rectangle.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Y coordinate of the image rectangle.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the image rectangle.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the image rectangle.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How to scale the image to fit its rectangle.
